script: Never text her "Hey, beautiful." It's what every other guy says. Send her this question instead: "Beautiful" puts her on a pedestal, and she's seen it a hundred times. Here are two flirty questions that make you stand out. Number one: "I have a crazy guess about you. Wanna hear it?" That grabs her attention right away, and usually makes her laugh. And to keep the conversation flowing, ask her: "What's something unique about you that nobody would guess?" When she replies, tell her: "You're definitely someone full of surprises." It's playful, and keeps her curious. And that's it. Two simple questions, and you stand out from the rest. Now comment the word GUESS, and I'll send you my free playbook.
